text: The course of Nursing has Autumn intake only. Objectives: Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine.These medical professionals should undertake medical diagnosis, treatments and prevention on common and frequently occurring diseases of oral cavity in health and medical institutions. Degree Awarded: Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation: Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.
